**Which area**
- [ ] CLI (`cli/`)
- [ ] Runtime (`runtime/`)

**What are you proposing**

**Why**
What workflow does this unblock or improve, once implemented?

**Note**
This repo is a placeholder (see [README.md](../../README.md)) — this issue is for
design discussion, not an implementation request. If you want to write code today,
see [quantara-core](https://github.com/quantarahq/quantara-core) and
[quantara-web](https://github.com/quantarahq/quantara-web) instead.
